description: Up to 20 read ops (balance, token, code, nonce, tx, block, gas, network) in ONE $0.01 call — $0.0005 per read, cheaper than any single-read seller. Each op is isolated: a bad op returns an error object, never fails the batch. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: POST https://api.firstmention.uk/s/chainread/multiread

chain.description: Default chain for ops that omit one (base or ethereum)
